articles.summary: BLACKSBURG, VA, MAY 14, 2025: The Board of Directors of National Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ Capital Market: NKSH) today approved payment on June 2, 2025 of a semi-annual dividend of $0.73 per share to all stockholders of record as of May 27, 2025. Chairman and CEO F. Brad Denardo commented, National Bankshares has offered an outstanding dividend for many years, and we are pleased to continue our tradition with this latest payment. We look forward to upholding and enhancing our stockholders investment in National Bankshares for many years to come. In other business, the Board renewed its authorization of a stock repurchase plan under which management is authorized to purchase up to 250,000 shares of National Bankshares, Inc.s common stock in the open market. The authorization extends from June 1, 2025 to May 31, 2026. The Companys current stock repurchase plan expires on May 31, 2025. The Companys management has not yet determined
articles.title: National Bankshares, Inc. Declares Semi-Annual Dividend
